description.narrative: The objective of the Project is the financing of the construction, operation and maintenance of a 50MW wind park and its associated facilities including a 19km 132 kV transmission line, and an a second phase that will add additional 50MW of installed capacity. The total project cost is approximately US$ 200 million and will be financed on a corporate basis. The financial plan for the project will include an A loan of up to US$ 100 million with a 9 year tenor, and a B loan of up to US$ 100 million with a tenor of up to 7 years. The loan will also include a grace period of up to 3 years. The project will contribute to the development of renewable energy in Argentina by contributing to the diversification of its energy matrix. The first phase of the project will add 50 MW of renewable capacity to the national grid thus decreasing fossil fuel generation reliance; and by displacing approximately 127,970 equivalent tons of carbon emissions per year.
